issues.span: 接受、記住、讀誦，而且明白
issues.evidence: Academic lists five verbs: take up, hold, remember, recite, fully understand; the children's text folds the first three into two verbs.
issues.fix: 還有，須菩提！任何好人家的兒子或女兒，接受、守住、記住、讀誦，而且明白這類經書裡的句子，他們將會受到折磨，

issues.span: 他們以前做過、會帶來不快樂的來生的壞行為
issues.evidence: Tangled nested clause for ages 8-12; meaning is intact (the earlier bad deeds that would lead to an unhappy rebirth will be purified).
issues.fix: 因為這輩子受到折磨，他們以前做的那些壞行為就會被洗乾淨，不再帶來不快樂的來生，

issues.evidence: Tibetan/academic give a precise number: eighty-four hundred-thousand ten-millions (nayutas) of buddhas, and 'innumerable and even more innumerable' eons; the children's text reduces this to 'very many' and loses the 'even more innumerable' and 'even earlier' emphasis.
issues.fix: 須菩提！我記得在很久很久、數也數不清的漫長歲月之前，在燃燈佛出現以前，更早更早的時候，出現過八十四億那由他百千位佛陀。我都讓他們很開心，

issues.span: 如果有哪個好人家的兒子或女兒，得到了這麼一大堆福氣。如果我把
issues.evidence: The first sentence is an incomplete fragment; the Tibetan is one conditional sentence ('if I were to declare the merit of those who would hold so much merit').
issues.fix: 須菩提！在那個時候，如果我把那些得到這麼一大堆福氣的好人家的兒子或女兒，他們的福氣有多少都說出來，眾生聽了就會發瘋，心裡會亂成一團。

issues.evidence: Academic: 'even if one gives rise to the notion up to (乃至) person' — a range running from being up to person; the children's text names only 'person' and loses the 'up to' range.
issues.fix: 因為不管是把別人想成眾生，還是想成「人」，只要有這樣的想法，他就不叫做菩薩。

issues.evidence: Academic: 授記 (prediction); the glossary term used for this elsewhere is 預言, but the children's text uses a plain 'say', losing that Dipamkara made a prediction.
issues.fix: 如來燃燈佛就不會對我預言說：

issues.evidence: Academic: because there is no dharma by which the Tathagata fully awakens to the unsurpassed awakening; the children's wording ('there is no thing at all when he awakens') can be read as 'nothing exists'.
issues.fix: 因為沒有任何事物，是如來靠它完全覺悟到最高、圓滿的覺悟的。
